EXECUTION_POLICIES: **Granularity**: - 1-3 steps per decision, each with checkable expected_output - Step ``id``: short local tokens within the plan only (e.g. ``01``, ``02``). ``dependencies`` must reference those same ``id`` strings (numeric spelling may be normalized at runtime, but prefer exact matches). - Step descriptions: imperative tool actions (not raw goal string) - Merge related filesystem reads into one step when sequential tool-only - Parallel mode: independent readonly steps may run together if descriptions name disjoint scopes (e.g. separate explore targets)
